name: Valuable Vantages
label: Quest
description: Valuable Vantages: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Our high command inserts strategic troops using bat riders. Key points around the foothills have lost their signaling beacons.

Take these vials. Uncork them in three locations: the hills bordering Dun Garok, the plateau overlooking Dunholde Keep, and the last on the ridge of the Headland above the town of Hillsbrad. The vapors that emanate will be like a potent tuning rod to the senses of the bat, drawing them to the desired drop-off points once more.
Look for crushed empty vials and renew our marks.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Good work. We advance the plans.
Let purpose guide your strikes, friend.

sources.title: Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
